description: This file defines the Address model class within the Opencart project. It contains methods for creating, editing, deleting, and fetching address records associated with customer accounts in an e-commerce application. The class interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations on the address data and includes logic for handling related localization models.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing customer address data, including CRUD operations and retrieval of address details for display or modification within the user account context.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address record in the database for a specified customer, returning the new address ID, and ensures only one default address per customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address record for a customer and manages the default address status.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes one or more address records for a customer, optionally specifying a particular address ID to delete.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific address, including related country, zone, and address format data.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Fetches all addresses for a specified customer, including enriched locale data.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses associated with a particular customer.
